notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q966038_pavlopetri.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/placekit.py) with AI assistance. In 3-4 m off Pounta, Laconia: the heart of the Bronze Age town, about 160 m across — houses and larger courtyard buildings in blocks along the streets, their stone walls standing a course or two above the sand, a cemetery of cist graves, sherds of pottery. The whole site covers some 8 hectares. The plan is drawn in outline after the published site plans: the line of each wall and building is approximate. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
